script:
Boss Zhang (Gas Station Owner)
Boss Zhang runs a gas station in town and usually doesn't have much to do. This town is quite chaotic, and people often come to the gas station to buy gasoline privately without proper purchase procedures. Boss Zhang, happy to make money, usually turns a blind eye.
Boss Zhang and Yao Qianshu, the pawn shop owner in town, are drinking buddies. On the surface, they seem to have a good private relationship, but actually each hopes the other will pay for drinks. Once, Boss Zhang brought the drunk Yao Qianshu home and found his wife Sister Wang quite charming, so he began scheming. Who would have thought that Sister Wang also seemed to be someone who couldn't bear loneliness? One thing led to another, and the two got together. They often met at the tavern on the other side of town - Boss Zhang entering through the back door, Sister Wang through the front door.
Sister Wang told him that Yao Qianshu wasn't a good person either and had found a mistress outside. Although she didn't know who it was, it was definitely a woman from town.
Two years ago, the villa next to Boss Zhang that had been vacant was suddenly bought, and the person who moved in was called Li Changqing, a man with half his face burned, looking quite terrifying. His family hired a nanny, who was Sister Wang's good friend Nanny Jia.
One day, after Sister Wang had another big fight with Yao Qianshu, she met Boss Zhang at the tavern. While drinking, Sister Wang told Boss Zhang that Yao Qianshu had a bag of jewelry with gems worth ten to twenty million altogether. Yao Qianshu planned to sell these things and elope with his mistress. Sister Wang asked Boss Zhang to find a way to get this bag of gems and not let Yao Qianshu succeed.
On August 25th, Sister Wang told Boss Zhang that Yao Qianshu had set the transaction time for 11 PM on August 30th at the clock tower in South Town. They would seize the jewelry then, and if they were recognized, they would kill Yao Qianshu. People die for wealth - Boss Zhang didn't hesitate much and agreed to this. The next day, Boss Zhang dug a pit in the orchard across from his house, planning to use it to bury Yao Qianshu's body.
[August 30th Evening]
Boss Zhang drove to near the clock tower and waited until 11 o'clock, then drove to the clock tower. He found a car parked in the temporary parking area by the roadside. Because it was raining heavily, he couldn't see clearly who was sitting in the car. He came to the clock tower and found a car parked beside it with both doors wide open. When he went over to look, he found that Yao Qianshu was already dead in the passenger seat of the car. He searched Yao Qianshu's pockets - the gem bag was still there. He took the gems and prepared to escape, but when he went back to look, his car was gone. He could only hide by the roadside. Then a car came, and the person in the car got out to look at Yao Qianshu's car, then quickly ran away. Boss Zhang felt that just hiding there wasn't a solution, so he could only drive the car with Yao Qianshu's body back home.
At 11:30, he returned to his doorstep and dragged Yao Qianshu's body to the orchard across the road to bury it. The heavy rain quickly washed away the bloodstains on the road, saving him a lot of trouble. After burying the body and returning to the car, he found the car was locked. He quickly went back to check but couldn't see anything. Anxious, he fired a shot at where the body was buried but didn't seem to hit anyone. Then he hurriedly returned home. Back home, he took out the gem bag and found a particularly large and dazzling blue diamond inside. He knew this blue diamond was very valuable and hid it.
On August 31st, the next day, Boss Zhang went to check the body again but found it was gone, leaving no traces. He had no choice but to quickly pack his luggage and then go find Sister Wang. He gave all the remaining gems to Sister Wang, told her he hadn't heard any news about Yao Qianshu being discovered yet, and asked her to quickly pack up and prepare to leave.
Only Clue (Not actively exposing +10 points):
Sister Wang instigated him to kill Yao Qianshu.
